metrics.headline: Anthropic Dario Amodei: 'We Must Pace the Frontier' — employee-level access for third-party evaluators
metrics.body_excerpt: Anthropic's Dario Amodei published 'We Must Pace the Frontier' pledging permanent, employee-level access for third-party evaluators. Sam Altman said OpenAI would match the evaluator step. Elon Musk publicly agreed. Three rival labs lining up behind a slower capability cadence is rarer than another model launch and frames the week around control of agents rather than raw scores.
